examples.question_text:
$y$ varies directly with $x$. When $x=12$, $y=18$.

(a) Find the equation relating $y$ and $x$.

(b) Find $y$ when $x=22$.

(c) Find $x$ when $y=45$.
examples.solution_text:
(a) Write $y=kx$ and substitute the known pair.

$\begin{aligned}18&=12k\\k&=\frac{18}{12}\\k&=1.5\end{aligned}$

The equation is $y=1.5x$.

(b) Substitute $x=22$.

$\begin{aligned}y&=1.5(22)\\y&=33\end{aligned}$

(c) Substitute $y=45$.

$\begin{aligned}45&=1.5x\\x&=\frac{45}{1.5}\\x&=30\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text:
The amount of petrol $P$, in litres, used at a constant speed varies directly with distance $d$, in kilometres. A car uses $5.4\text{ L}$ to travel $48\text{ km}$.

(a) Find the equation relating $P$ and $d$, and explain what the constant represents.

(b) Find the petrol needed to travel $137\text{ km}$. Round to $2$ decimal places.

(c) How far can the car travel using $18\text{ L}$ at the same speed?
examples.solution_text:
(a) Write $P=kd$ and substitute the known pair.

$\begin{aligned}5.4&=48k\\k&=\frac{5.4}{48}\\k&=0.1125\end{aligned}$

The equation is $P=0.1125d$. The constant represents petrol use of $0.1125\text{ L}$ per kilometre.

(b) Substitute $d=137$.

$\begin{aligned}P&=0.1125(137)\\P&=15.4125\end{aligned}$

The car needs $15.41\text{ L}$.

(c) Substitute $P=18$.

$\begin{aligned}18&=0.1125d\\d&=\frac{18}{0.1125}\\d&=160\end{aligned}$

The car can travel $160\text{ km}$.

examples.question_text:
In this table, $y$ varies directly with $x$. Write the equation and find $a$ and $b$.

$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline x&4&7&10&b\\\hline y&14&24.5&a&63\\\hline\end{array}$
examples.solution_text:
Write $y=kx$ and use the first known pair.

$\begin{aligned}14&=4k\\k&=\frac{14}{4}\\k&=3.5\end{aligned}$

The second known pair agrees: $24.5=3.5(7)$. The equation is $y=3.5x$.

For $x=10$:

$\begin{aligned}a&=3.5(10)\\a&=35\end{aligned}$

For $y=63$:

$\begin{aligned}63&=3.5b\\b&=\frac{63}{3.5}\\b&=18\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text:
The time $t$, in minutes, needed to heat a meal varies inversely with the microwave power setting $p$, expressed as a percentage. The meal takes $5\text{ min}$ at $48\%$ power.

(a) Find the equation relating $t$ and $p$.

(b) How long does the meal take at $75\%$ power? Give the answer in minutes and seconds.

(c) What power setting would heat the meal in $4\text{ min}$?
examples.solution_text:
(a) Write $t=\frac{k}{p}$, using $p=48$ for $48\%$.

$\begin{aligned}5&=\frac{k}{48}\\k&=5(48)\\k&=240\end{aligned}$

The equation is $t=\frac{240}{p}$.

(b) Substitute $p=75$.

$\begin{aligned}t&=\frac{240}{75}\\t&=3.2\end{aligned}$

Convert the fractional minute: $0.2(60)=12\text{ s}$. The time is $3\text{ min }12\text{ s}$.

(c) Substitute $t=4$.

$\begin{aligned}4&=\frac{240}{p}\\4p&=240\\p&=60\end{aligned}$

The required power setting is $60\%$.

examples.question_text:
Determine whether this table shows inverse proportion. Explain your answer by calculating every product $xy$. If it does, write the equation relating $y$ and $x$.

$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline x&2&3&8&12\\\hline y&42&28&10.5&7\\\hline\end{array}$
examples.solution_text:
Calculate every product.

$\begin{aligned}2(42)&=84\\3(28)&=84\\8(10.5)&=84\\12(7)&=84\end{aligned}$

Every pair has the same nonzero product, so the table shows inverse proportion. Since $xy=84$, the equation is $y=\frac{84}{x}$.
